methodology.scan_pattern: Certified items with DifficultyScore >= 3, stem containing definitional language, non-calculation items
filters_applied: Definitional phrasing: which/what/how + ?, or is/are/refers to/means/describes
methodology.recall: 533 candidates across all 5 packs, capturing ~90% of genuine definition-match items

short_stem_subset.description: Items with stem <= 100 chars — strongest DL-031 signal

medium_stem_subset.description: Items with stem 101-150 chars and clear definitional structure

template_rotation_note: Pack C and D have many 5-item rotation groups where the same stem is duplicated across items with only company-name substitution. These inflate the candidate count by ~4x. Unique definition-match topics are ~100-120 across all packs.
